nodes.header: Jon is starting his own dance studio business
nodes.body: After losing his banker job (2023-01-19), Jon is starting his own business: a dance studio. His motivation is to share his passion for dance with others and teach them the joy that dancing brings him. As of 2023-01-29, Jon was actively searching for a studio location — 'on the hunt for the ideal spot' — and had identified a downtown candidate with great natural light ('I even found a place with great natural light!'). He had settled on Marley flooring as his choice for the studio floor, citing grip, flexibility, durability, and easy cleaning. He framed the search as 'a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking.' As of 2023-02-01, he was still searching for a place and described the journey as 'bumpy, but I'm determined to make it work' — 'still following my passion for dance.' As of 2023-02-04, Jon is still searching, calling the location search 'tricky' but staying determined — 'Searching for a dance studio location has been tricky, but I'm determined to find the right spot - when I do, I'm sure the rest will follow!' He was also facing business setbacks around this time but pushing through. As of 2023-03-16, Jon described his venture as 'hectic' and 'tough' but said 'I'm livin' my dreams now' and 'I keep facing new challenges, but I'm sure it'll be worth it in the end' — he had started hitting the gym the previous week to stay on track with the venture. As of 2023-04-03, Jon had shut down his bank account to support the business ('I had to shut down my bank account. It was tough, but I needed to do it for my biz'), was expanding the studio's social media presence, offering workshops and classes to local schools and centers as outreach, and preparing to host a multi-school dance competition in May 2023 to showcase local talent. As of 2023-04-25, he is actively promoting the studio at public events (e.g., attended a fair on 2023-04-24 to showcase it and generate leads). As of 2023-05-11, he reports 'things are looking up' with the studio and frames the journey as 'stepping into the unknown' but pursuing his dream business. He says he's 'living the dream' by having his own dance studio and teaching others. As of 2023-05-27, he is wrapping up the business plan, actively searching for investors (finding it tough but staying hopeful), and reading 'The Lean Startup' for business tips. He uses a whiteboard to track ideas, milestones, and key dates. As of 2023-06-13, Jon is 'prepping more than ever' — working with young dancers whose passion is inspiring, and offering dance classes, workshops, and one-on-one mentoring/training. He uses a clipboard/notepad system alongside his color-coded whiteboard to stay organized and motivated. As of 2023-06-19, Jon announced the official grand opening night is 2023-06-20 ('tomorrow') and he is 'working hard to make everything just right.' He said 'It's been a wild ride, but I'm feeling good and ready to give it my best.' The week before the opening (week of 2023-06-12), he took a short trip to Rome to clear his mind before the launch. As of 2023-07-09, Jon has committed to going full-time with his dance studio business: 'I'm gonna stay determined and make my own path by going full-time with my biz idea.' He is also learning marketing and analytics tools to push the business forward. As of 2023-07-21, the dance studio is 'on tenuous grounds' but Jon is staying positive; he has taken a temp job to cover expenses while looking for investors, is sprucing up the business plan and tweaking his investor pitch, and is building an online platform to showcase the studio's offerings. He recently attended a networking event where he met investors and got useful advice. As of 2023-07-23, Jon has been 'rehearsing hard and working on business plans' — 'It's been stressful, but dancing has kept me going.' He articulated his studio's vision: to 'welcome dancers of all ages and backgrounds' as a go-to spot for self-expression.

Cheers!' On 2023-04-25, after exchanging encouragement, Jon said 'We'll keep pushing each other on this path' and Gina replied 'Yeah! Let's keep each other going. We can do it!' Advice flows both ways: on 2023-03-23 Jon gave Gina a three-part business framework (brand identity, customer relationships, staying positive) when she asked for tips on running a successful biz. Gina has repeatedly given Jon actionable business advice: motivation/confidence strategies (2023-04-25), marketing tips using social media and influencers (2023-06-16), starting-out principles — stay passionate, focused, resilient, believe in yourself, keep learning (2023-06-16), and networking as a path to sourcing/connections (2023-07-21). Jon applies her advice (e.g., on 2023-06-16 reported posting dance videos on social media as she suggested; on 2023-07-21 reported networking had gotten him 'good stuff') and treats her as a trusted sounding board. As of 2023-07-21, the relationship escalated from advice-giving to active collaboration: Gina agreed to help Jon create content and manage his dance studio's social media accounts.
